## Original authors list:

Elena Fernández Álvaro, Phat Voong Vinh, Cristina de Cozar, David R Willé, Beatriz Urones, Alvaro Cortés, Alan Price, Nhu Tran Do Hoang, Tuyen Ha Thanh, Molly McCloskey, Shareef Shaheen, Denise Dayao, Jaime de Mercado, Pablo Castañeda, Adolfo García-Perez, Benson Singa, Patricia Pavlinac, Judd Walson, Maria Santos Martínez-Martínez, Samuel LM Arnold, Saul Tzipori, Lluis Ballell Pages, Stephen Baker

## Details for the omitted authors

### Amanda Martinot

Department of Infectious Disease and Global Health, Tufts University Cummings School of Veterinary Medicine, North Grafton, United States.

Contribution: Formal analysis, Methodology, Validation, Visualization, Histopathology

Competing interests: No competing interests declared

All authors have agreed to the change to add the omitted author to the author list.

We also incorrectly spelt Saul Tzipori’s name in the published article, where their first name had been swapped with their surname. Their name has now been corrected to read Saul Tzipori.

The article has been corrected accordingly.

results.result: Amanda Martinot was omitted from the original author list of 23 authors and has been added to the corrected author list of 24 authors. Her affiliation is the Department of Infectious Disease and Global Health at Tufts University, and she contributed to formal analysis, methodology, validation, visualization, and histopathology. All authors agreed to this correction.
results.evaluation: Claims C1-C4, C8-C10 provide consistent and verifiable information about the authorship correction. The original list (C10) had 23 authors, the new list (C9) has 24 authors, and the difference is Amanda Martinot's addition (C8). Her affiliation (C1), contributions (C2), competing interests (C3), and author consent (C4) are all explicitly documented.

results.result: Saul Tzipori's name was incorrectly spelled in the original publication with the first name and surname swapped, and this error has been corrected in the article.
results.evaluation: Claims C5-C7 provide clear documentation of the spelling error and its correction. The manuscript explicitly states the nature of the error (first name and surname swapped) and confirms the correction has been implemented. This is a straightforward administrative correction with direct textual support.
